ignore: **/generated/**
// Declaration files are consumed by TSC, never imported at runtime, so the
// only edge to one is a module resolution knip does not follow. The ESM and
// CJS suffixes are listed beside the plain one because a build script that
// has to be JS (see packages/ui/scripts/build-entries.mjs) carries its types
// in a .d.mts, and a list of one exact suffix reads every such file as dead.
**/*.d.mts
**/*.d.cts
// Schema partials are consumed by scripts/sync-*-schema.mjs, which COPY
// them by path rather than importing them, so knip cannot see the edge
// and reports every partial as an unused file.
**/prisma/*.prisma
// harness/ is a CONSUMER fixture, not shipped code. Its package.json is
// generated by scripts/harness-install.mjs (and gitignored), and its files
// are entry points reached by vite/playwright config rather than by any
// import knip can follow — so every one of them reads as unused here.
harness/**
// The payments-portability gate's proof material: deliberate rule
// violations linted through the real config by
// scripts/payments-portability-selftest.mjs under a pretend file path.
// Nothing imports them — that is the point — so knip reads every one
// as an unused file.
scripts/payments-portability-fixtures/**

ignoreDependencies: // Every package's .releaserc.json names this in `extends`, which is how
// a release is scoped to the one package's directory. knip reads the
// `plugins` of a semantic-release config but does not follow `extends`,
// so the only reference to it is invisible from here.
// Spawned by scripts/release-tags.mjs as `pnpm exec semantic-release`.
// It used to be an inline `run:` step in ci.yml, where knip's GitHub
// Actions plugin could see the binary; now the only reference is an
// argument string inside a spawn, which no static analysis can follow.
